name: hud_layout_node_apply_text_label
description: HudUiLayoutNode::ApplyTextLabel applies layout text, base position, and optional XY offset to a HUD panel.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; this helper is deferred to a coherent HUD layout/text/source-cluster tier S pass.
